scope: Apollo landscape VT feedback: target renderer pass and draw binding investigation
result: No safe integration implemented; the existing rejection remains necessary.

target_source_evidence.finding: The getter supplies the feedback buffer UAV or an empty fallback. The pass-binding function currently returns immediately, even though BeginRenderingGBuffer calls it when virtual texturing is enabled. Its call alone does not establish a pixel UAV descriptor.
The current View uniform receives the getter's UAV. The recovered original-layout View proxy has no such resource.
The available mesh-draw resource Add overload accepts an SRV, not a UAV. Binding an arbitrary direct UAV cannot be implemented through that existing draw-binding interface.

Direct pixel binding dispatches to a Vulkan stage-global index; uniform-buffer resource binding indexes the actual buffer's resource array. Neither accepts the original D3D u7 as a ready Vulkan global index or an index from another uniform-buffer layout.

integration_requirements: Prepare a validated converted Vulkan global for the reflected storage texel buffer and use the converted global index, not D3D register 7.

Provide a draw-time binding route with the real feedback UAV, correct ordering, lifetime and transitions, or a target-only resource-bearing uniform-buffer layout with matching actual resource array and header mapping.
Verify original feedback addressing and request encoding against the target feedback consumer before enabling live requests.
Exercise installed shader, descriptor and feedback through a Vulkan draw; retain the adapter rejection until all requirements hold.
limits: Source inspection only; no original renderer binding capture, runtime descriptor validation, shader-map attachment, Vulkan draw or feedback readback. A source analogy and target getter do not prove compatible feedback semantics.
